notes: counted = model's share of the expected two-way votes already counted (timeline); map f = share of the municipality's polling sections received.
Count path rebuilt from each section's TSE receipt time (DT_BU_RECEBIDO + 3 h = UTC), not from the results site's publication times.

stats.settle = first time after which P (model) or the price (market) stayed >= 0.9 on the eventual winner to the end (the registered definition, night.evaluate); it can fall before 1% is counted when the prior alone already gives P >= 0.9.
Prior: 2026 first round by municipality, same two candidates.
pm = Polymarket last traded price of the YES (= candidate a) side, carried forward minute by minute.

stats.settle_gated: model = max(registered model settle, gate), gate = first minute with >= 1% counted in that race; lead = minutes from the model's gated settle to lead_vs settling (positive: model first).

kalshi = Kalshi P(candidate a) from 1-minute candles: bid/ask midpoint when the spread is at most 10¢, else the last trade; YES = b markets are inverted. Prices © Kalshi, shown as derived charts with credit.
